name: Leboncoin Immobilier
positioning: The generalist classified site that became France's highest-traffic property channel — private sellers and agencies side by side.
description: Leboncoin's real estate section carries both private-seller and professional listings for sale and rental across France, sold to professionals through listing packs and visibility options, and benefiting from the traffic of one of the country's largest websites.
real_estate_use: Its dual nature defines its role. Agencies advertise here for volume at a lower cost per listing than the professional portals. At the same time it is the main source for the pige — the private-seller listings that agencies canvass for mandates. The same platform is therefore both a marketing channel and a prospecting ground.
features: Private and professional sale and rental listings
Professional listing packs and visibility options
Rental application handling for some listing types

use_cases.job: Reach the largest French property audience at a lower cost per listing
Identify private sellers to canvass for a mandate
